stops.note: meant 'wages' or 'hire' among South Indian laborers
Portuguese traders in South India applied the word to hired laborers
merged with an unrelated Gujarati tribal name and spread across India
entered English through colonial trade and labor systems
stops.meaning: an unskilled laborer (now dated and offensive)

current_meaning: A historical, now offensive, term for an unskilled Asian laborer hired cheaply under colonial-era labor systems.
